propositions: Close must verify that the current plan review is certified and material-current before allowing a task/story/epic to close, preventing closure when plan or upstream pins changed during execution

The close gate must accept code/file-dependency drift (enabled by CLOSE profile) while rejecting unsigned reviews, reopened states, registry staleness, own-material drift, phase incompatibility, and pin violations (when enforced)

The gate check must run inside the existing transaction lock after structural checks but before STATUS append, with a fresh state recheck to catch plan/signature/phase/material/pin changes between precheck and lock
Configuration flag require_plan_review_for_close defaults false, preserving all existing close behavior with zero plan-review reads when disabled
Unexpected local read/parser/signature exceptions must fail closed as verdict unavailable without traceback or network calls

Existing exemptions (bugs, session logs, code reviews, identities, idea→closed) and force-close bypass behavior are preserved exactly; non-empty force-close reason bypasses both gates but never bypasses structural child closure
